'''Clue scroll (master)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (master)|master]] [[Treasure Trails]].

To access the clue location, travel to the [[Iceberg]] with a [[Clockwork suit]] and ask [[Larry]] to transform you into it. While disguised, pass through the avalanche north-west of the boat to enter the KGP base.
